meals.name: One-Pot Creamy Chicken and Rice Casserole
meals.description: Tender chicken thighs baked with fluffy rice, sweet peas and carrots in a creamy, savory sauce. A comforting family dinner with minimal cleanup.

meals.name: Lemon Herb Chicken and Rice Soup
meals.description: A soothing, brothy soup with shredded chicken, rice, celery and carrots, brightened with a squeeze of lemon. Perfect for warming up on a damp evening.

meals.name: Chicken Biryani-Style Rice Pilaf
meals.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with yogurt-marinated chicken, warm spices and sweet caramelized onions. Gently spiced and deeply comforting.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Soup
meals.description: A comforting, velvety soup loaded with tender chicken, carrots, celery and rice, perfect for warming up on a drizzly evening.

meals.name: One-Pot Baked Chicken and Rice with Peas
meals.description: Juicy chicken thighs nestled in fluffy, golden stock-infused rice, baked together in one dish with sweet peas for easy cosy comfort.

meals.name: Lemon Herb Chicken Congee
meals.description: A silky, gently simmered rice porridge with shredded chicken, ginger and spring onion, finished with a drizzle of soy and sesame for soothing comfort.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Soup
meals.description: A comforting, velvety soup loaded with tender chicken, carrots, celery and rice, perfect for warming up on a rainy night.

meals.name: One-Pot Baked Chicken Thigh and Rice
meals.description: Juicy paprika-spiced chicken thighs nestled on fluffy rice that bakes in savoury stock with peas and onion, all in one dish.

meals.name: Chicken and Broccoli Cheesy Rice Casserole
meals.description: Tender chicken and broccoli folded into creamy, cheesy rice and baked until bubbling and golden on top.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender chicken and crisp vegetables tossed with silky rice noodles in a creamy, savory-sweet satay sauce made with sunflower seed butter, so it is completely nut-free and mild enough for the kids.

meals.name: Creamy Satay Tofu and Veggie Udon
meals.description: Chewy udon noodles and golden pan-fried tofu with cabbage, carrot and pepper, coated in a rich, creamy sunflower seed satay sauce with a hint of honey. A mild vegetarian option.

meals.name: Satay Shrimp Noodle Stir-Fry with Egg and Bean Sprouts
meals.description: A Thai-style stir-fry of juicy shrimp, scrambled egg and crunchy bean sprouts with egg noodles in a rich, creamy nut-free satay sauce, finished with a squeeze of lime.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender chicken and crisp vegetables tossed with rice noodles in a creamy, savory-sweet satay sauce made with sunflower seed butter, so it's completely nut-free and mild enough for kids.

meals.name: Beef Satay Egg Noodle Stir-Fry with Cabbage
meals.description: Quick-seared strips of beef and shredded cabbage with chewy egg noodles in a rich, gently spiced satay sauce with a hint of mild curry and honey sweetness.

meals.name: Tofu and Mushroom Satay Udon Stir-Fry
meals.description: Crispy golden tofu, mushrooms, and snap peas with thick udon noodles, all coated in a silky, nut-free satay sauce with a touch of sesame and maple sweetness.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender chicken, crisp broccoli, carrot and bell pepper tossed with rice noodles in a creamy, savory-sweet satay sauce made with nut-free sunflower seed butter. Mild and kid-friendly.

meals.name: Beef and Cabbage Satay Udon
meals.description: Thick, chewy udon noodles with sliced beef, cabbage, snap peas and carrot, coated in a thick, rich satay-style sauce with a touch of hoisin sweetness. No heat, so the whole family can enjoy it.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu Satay Egg Noodles
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu cubes with zucchini, bell pepper and edamame tossed through egg noodles in a creamy ginger-lime satay sauce. A hearty vegetarian option that is gently flavored for kids.

meals.name: Summer Cod and Pea Paella
meals.description: A classic skillet paella with saffron-scented rice, flaky cod, sweet peas and roasted red pepper, finished with a squeeze of lemon.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Salmon and Asparagus Paella
meals.description: A hands-off paella-style bake with golden turmeric rice, tender asparagus and roasted salmon chunks, topped with fresh dill and lemon.

meals.name: Chilled Tuna Paella Rice Salad
meals.description: A cool, make-ahead take on paella for hot days: saffron rice tossed with tuna, cherry tomatoes, peas, cucumber and olives in a lemony dressing.

meals.name: Summer Cod and Saffron Paella
meals.description: A classic-style paella made with flaky white fish, sweet peppers, peas and smoky paprika. It's cooked in one pan and finished with a squeeze of lemon, and it's completely shellfish-free.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Salmon and Green Bean Paella
meals.description: Saffron-scented rice bakes in the oven with tender green beans and is topped with juicy salmon fillets. It's an easy, hands-off take on paella that develops a lovely crust on the bottom.

meals.name: Chilled Paella-Style Tuna Rice Salad
meals.description: A refreshing summer take on paella with saffron rice, tuna, roasted peppers, cucumber and olives in a lemony olive oil dressing. Make it ahead and serve cold on a hot day.

meals.name: Summer Cod and Pea Paella
meals.description: A classic stovetop paella with saffron-scented rice, flaky cod, sweet peas and roasted red pepper, finished with a squeeze of lemon. It's all the flavor of a seafood paella with no shellfish.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Salmon and Summer Vegetable Paella
meals.description: A hands-off paella-style rice bake with juicy salmon chunks, zucchini, green beans and cherry tomatoes. Smoky paprika and turmeric give it a golden color, and it needs very little stirring.

meals.name: Fish Fideuà with Lemon Garlic Mayo
meals.description: Fideuà is the noodle cousin of paella. Toasted vermicelli simmers in saffron-tomato broth with tender white fish and is served with a quick lemony garlic mayo. It cooks fast and suits a casual summer table.

meals.name: Vegan Smoky Tofu Carbonara
meals.description: Silky spaghetti coated in a rich, cheesy sauce made from silken tofu and nutritional yeast, topped with crispy smoky tofu pieces and lots of black pepper. It has all the comfort of a classic carbonara without the eggs or dairy.

meals.name: Creamy Cashew Alfredo Fettuccine with Mushrooms
meals.description: Ribbons of fettuccine tossed in a luscious garlicky cashew cream sauce with golden sautéed mushrooms and wilted spinach. It's restaurant-style indulgence that's easy to make at home.

meals.name: Roasted Butternut Squash & Sage Cream Rigatoni
meals.description: Sweet roasted butternut squash blended into a velvety, cheesy sauce with garlic and crispy sage, clinging to every ridge of rigatoni. Cozy, romantic and totally dairy-free.

meals.name: Vegan Smoky Tofu Carbonara
meals.description: Silky cashew and nutritional yeast sauce clings to spaghetti with crisp smoky tofu standing in for the bacon. It has a peppery, savory richness that feels special enough for date night.

meals.name: Creamy White Bean Mushroom Alfredo Fettuccine
meals.description: Blended white beans and garlic make a velvety, cheesy-tasting Alfredo sauce without any dairy. Tossed with golden mushrooms and wilted spinach for a cozy, restaurant-style dinner.

meals.name: Ultra-Cheesy Vegan Mac with Broccoli
meals.description: Elbow macaroni coated in a luscious potato and carrot cheese sauce, boosted with nutritional yeast and a touch of mustard. Broccoli adds freshness to this comforting bowl.

meals.name: Vegan Smoky Tofu Carbonara
meals.description: Silky spaghetti coated in a cashew and nutritional yeast cream, topped with crisp smoky tofu 'bacon' and plenty of black pepper. It has all the richness of a classic carbonara, with no eggs or dairy.

meals.name: Creamy Garlic Mushroom Fettuccine Alfredo
meals.description: Ribbons of fettuccine in a luscious oat cream and garlic sauce with a cheesy nutritional yeast finish, golden sautéed mushrooms and wilted spinach. It's cozy, elegant and ready in under 30 minutes.

meals.name: Butternut Squash & Cashew Cheese Rigatoni
meals.description: Rigatoni tossed in a velvety sauce of roasted butternut squash, cashews and nutritional yeast, with a hint of sage and garlic. It's rich, cheesy and comforting, with a naturally sweet, golden color.

meals.name: Tofu-avokaadokauss
meals.description: Kuldselt praetud tofu, kreemjas avokaado ja krõmpsuv kurk sushiriisi peal. Nori ribad ja seesam annavad sushi maitse.

meals.name: Muna-avokaadorullid
meals.description: Pehme munaomlett, avokaado ja kurk rullitud nori lehtedesse riisiga. Lõigatud kenadeks rullideks nagu maki.

meals.name: Sushi-burrito kanaga
meals.description: Mahlane praetud kanafilee, riis ja krõbedad köögiviljad suures nori lehes. Majoneesi ja sojakastmega maitsestatud käes söödav õhtusöök.

meals.name: Sushikauss tofuga
meals.description: Kuldne praetud tofu sushiriisil koos krõmpsuva kurgi, porgandi ja kreemja avokaadoga. Peale tuleb noristikku ja seesamit.

meals.name: Temaki munaomleti ja avokaadoga
meals.description: Krõbedad noriistmed käes keeratud rullideks, sees pehme munaomlett, avokaado ja värske kurk. Riis on kergelt hapukas nagu päris sushil.

meals.name: Praetud sushiriis kanaga
meals.description: Pannil kuldseks praetud riis kanatükkide, muna ja köögiviljadega. Sojakastme ja seesamiõliga maitsestatud, peale puistatud noririba.

meals.name: Tofu sushikauss
meals.description: Kuldne praetud tofu, kreemjas avokaado ja krõmpsuv kurk leotatud sushiriisil. Peal noriribad ja seesam.

meals.name: Muna ja kurgi sushirullid
meals.description: Pehme omlett, krõbe kurk ja avokaado sushiriisi ning nori sees. Rullid on valmis ilma toore kalata.

meals.name: Teriyaki kanakauss
meals.description: Mahlane kanafilee läikivas teriyaki kastmes sushiriisi ja aurutatud brokkoliga. Peal nori ja seesam.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sidruni ja kartulitega
meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee sidruni ja tilliga, kõrval kuldsed ahjukartulid ja krõmpsuv spargel. Kõik valmib ühel plaadil, nii et pidulik laud on kiiresti kaetud.

meals.name: Spinati-ricotta lasanje
meals.description: Kreemjas spinati-ricotta täidis, rikkalik tomatikaste ja sulanud mozzarella kuldse koorikuga. Sobib suurele seltskonnale ja meeldib ka väiksematele sööjatele.

meals.name: Ahjuriis kõrvitsa ja fetaga
meals.description: Pehme riis, magusad röstitud kõrvitsatükid ja kikerherned, peal soolane feta. Vürtsikas ja soe vorm, mis valmib ühes nõus ahjus.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sidrunivõiga
meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee küüslaugu-sidrunivõi all ja kuldsed ahjukartulid kõrval. Till annab värske lõpu.

meals.name: Spinati-ricotta lasanje
meals.description: Kihiline lasanje kreemja ricotta, spinati ja sulanud mozzarellaga. Pealt kuldne ja kergelt krõbe, sees tomatikaste.

meals.name: Ahjutursk kirsstomatitega
meals.description: Õrn tursafilee küpseb pehmete kirsstomatite, oliivide ja kapparitega. Kõrvale sobib kuldne kuskuss.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sparglitega
meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee sidruni ja tilliga, kõrval kuldsed ahjukartulid ja krõmpsuv spargel. Kõik valmib ühel plaadil.

meals.name: Spinati-rikotta lasanje
meals.description: Kihiline lasanje kreemja rikotta, spinati ja tomatikastmega, pealt sulanud mozzarella ja kuldne juustukoorik. Kuum ja pidulik, lastele kindlasti meeldib.

meals.name: Ahjupaella krevettidega
meals.description: Safraniv-paprikane riis krevettide, hernete ja punase paprikaga, ahjus pehmeks ja aromaatseks haudunud. Pealt sidrunilaastud ja värske petersell.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Pehmed soojad kartulid kreemjas jogurtikastmes ja kuldseks praetud suitsutofu tükkidega, nagu vanaema salat, aga taimne.

meals.name: Kartulisalat ahjuporgandiga
meals.description: Soe kartulisalat kaerakoorekastmes ja suitsupaprikaga röstitud porgandiga, mis toob lauda vanaaegse suitsuse maitse. Porgandid on ahjus kergelt karamelliseerunud.

meals.name: Soe kartuli-kikerhernesalat
meals.description: Soojad kartulid ja krõbedaks praetud kikerherned suitsupaprikaga, kõik kokku segatud kapparite ja jogurtikastmega. Hapukas ja kreemjas, nagu vanaema salat.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Pehmed kartulid taimse hapukoore, hapukurgi ja kuldseks praetud suitsutofuga. Maitse jääb vanaema salati moodi, aga kala asemel on suitsune tofu.

meals.name: Suitsuporgandi kartulisalat
meals.description: Suitsupaprikas ja sojakastmes röstitud porgandiribad meenutavad suitsukala. Soojad kartulid ja kreemjas murulaugukaste ühendavad kõik kokku.

meals.name: Kartulisalat valgete ubadega
meals.description: Soe kartul ja kreemjad valged oad kaerakoore-sinepikastmes, kapparite ja suitsupaprikaga. Hapukas ja suitsune maitse tuletab meelde vanaema suitsukalasalatit.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Soe kartul, kuldseks praetud suitsutofu ja hapukas jogurtikaste tilliga, täpselt nagu vanaema salat, aga taimsena.

meals.name: Kartulisalat suitsuporgandiga
meals.description: Soe kartul kreemja india pähklikastmega ja suitsupaprikas röstitud porgandiribad, mis meenutavad suitsukala. Peale murulauk.

meals.name: Ahjukartulisalat kikerhernestega
meals.description: Krõbedaks röstitud kartul ja suitsupaprikas kikerherned, segatud hapukase tillikastmega. Kapparid annavad kalamaitselise soolase noodi.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Rikkalik tomatikaste punaste läätsede ja porgandiga, mis kattub spagettidega pehmeks ja mahlaseks. Juust peale ja lapsed söövad taldriku tühjaks.

meals.name: Läätsetortillad juustuga
meals.description: Pehmed tortillad sooja läätse-maisitäidise, sulanud juustu ja koorja hapukoorega. Täidis hautub pannil kiiresti ja kogu asja saab ise kokku keerata.

meals.name: Kookosläätsesupp porgandiga
meals.description: Siidine oranž supp punaste läätsede, porgandi ja kartuliga, kookospiim teeb selle kreemjaks. Läätsed keevad pehmeks poole tunniga ja supi saab ühtlaseks blenderdada.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese
meals.description: Paks tomatikaste punaste läätsede ja riivitud porgandiga, mis keeb pehmeks ja kleepub spagettide külge. Peale läheb sulanud juust.

meals.name: Läätsekotletid jogurtikastmega
meals.description: Kuldse koorikuga kotletid punastest läätsedest ja porgandist. Kõrvale tuleb jahe jogurtikaste ja krõmpsuv kurk.

meals.name: Kookosläätsekarri riisiga
meals.description: Kreemjas ja õrna maitsega karri punaste läätsede ja spinatiga. Läätsed keevad kookospiimas pehmeks ning kõrvale tuleb kohev riis.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Kreemjas tomatikaste punaste läätsede ja porgandiga, mis keeb pehmeks poole tunniga. Peale riivitud juust ja kõik lisavad korduse.

meals.name: Läätsepihvid jogurtikastmega
meals.description: Kuldsed ja pehmed läätsepihvid porgandi ja köömnetega, kõrvale krõmpsuv kurk ja jahe jogurtikaste. Pihvid on seest õrnad ja väljast krõbedad.

meals.name: Kookosläätsekarri riisiga
meals.description: Pehme ja õrnalt vürtsikas karri punaste läätsede, porgandi ja maisiga kookospiimas. Kreemjas kaste imbub riisi sisse.
